_comment: One chapter per Create addon. Data only — the generator in build_quests.py turns each entry
THE SAFETY RULE: a task never asks for the addon's own items, only for common materials the
main questline already taught you to make. Rewards are what introduce the mod. That means
every quest is completable the moment you reach it, however deep that addon's own recipe tree
goes, and no quest can be gated behind a recipe nobody verified.
Rewards are entry tier and small. The point is to put a mod's starting block in your hand, not
create_aeronautics_toolgun is deliberately absent: all seven of its items are on the
toolgun_restricted list, so any quest for it would be uncompletable by design.

addons.title: Drive By Wire
addons.blurb: Wire a cockpit to the thing it is meant to fly.

quests.desc: Linked controllers let you steer a contraption from a seat instead of standing on it.
Wire runs from the hub to whatever it controls. Cutters undo your mistakes.
The tweaked hub does the same job with more channels.

addons.title: Aeroworks
addons.blurb: Cockpit furniture that actually does something.

quests.desc: A stand to mount controls on, so a cockpit stops being a wall of levers.
The desk is the flat version. Modules clip into either.
A yoke and a throttle quadrant. Now it feels like a cockpit.

addons.title: Create: Aeronautics
addons.blurb: The mod this whole server is named after.

quests.desc: A propeller and goggles. The goggles read airspeed and altitude.
Levitite blend crystallises into the block that makes things float.
A burner for hot air, and a bearing that keeps a propeller pointed where you want.

addons.title: Create: Offroad
addons.blurb: Wheels, for when flying is overkill.

quests.desc: A tire and the mount that holds it. Bolt them to a contraption and drive.
Small tires turn tighter. Large ones climb better.
A borehead bearing spins a cutting wheel. This is how you tunnel.

addons.title: Create: Simulated
addons.blurb: Physics parts: engines, sails, and things that hold together.

quests.desc: Handles to grab and augers to dig. The basics of a moving build.
An altitude sensor, and a diagram that shows what your contraption thinks it is.
Analog transmission and a directional gearshift, for drive trains that change their mind.

addons.title: Create Tracks
addons.blurb: Caterpillar tracks. Slower than wheels, stops for nothing.

quests.desc: Mounts hold the track. The key adjusts how hard the suspension pushes back.
Small drive wheels and short track sections — enough for a light crawler.
Full-size drive wheel and track. Heavy, slow, unstoppable.

addons.title: Crafts & Additions
addons.blurb: Rotation becomes electricity, and back again.

quests.desc: Wire and rods. Everything electrical here starts with these two.
A capacitor stores a little. Connectors move it between machines.
An alternator turns rotation into power; an accumulator holds it.

addons.title: Create: Connected
addons.blurb: The quality-of-life parts Create almost has.

quests.desc: Cross connectors route rotation through a junction. A crank wheel starts it by hand.
A brass gearbox, and a clutch that disengages on its own at speed.
A brake stops a line dead. Control chips make it conditional.

addons.title: Diesel Generators
addons.blurb: Oil, refining, and engines that drink it.

quests.desc: Canisters carry fuel. The burner is where it goes.
Chipped wood ferments into something you can burn. Asphalt is the by-product.
A distillation controller splits crude into the useful parts.

addons.title: Create: New Age
addons.blurb: Proper electricity, with wires that care about voltage.

quests.desc: Wire and connectors. Runs are limited, so plan the layout.
Blank circuits print into copper ones. These gate everything above.
A motor to spend power, and an energiser to make it.

addons.title: The Factory Must Grow
addons.blurb: Heavy industry. Steel, aluminium, and very large machines.

quests.desc: Aluminium is TFMG's entry metal. Light, and it does not rust.
Frames and cogs, so you can build in it rather than just hold it.
An air intake and a tank. The first machines want both.

addons.title: Create: Power Grid
addons.blurb: Real circuits. Voltage, current, and consequences.

quests.desc: A board and capacitors. Everything here is built on these.
A battery to store charge, and a bell for when something goes wrong.
A carbon pile resists on purpose. The heater turns that into warmth.

addons.title: Create: Numismatics
addons.blurb: Money, so trade stops being a chest of diamonds.

quests.desc: Spurs and cogs are the small coins. Everything else converts up from these.
A vendor sells for you. A depositor takes payment straight into an account.
A bank terminal, and the guide that explains the rest.

addons.title: Steam 'n' Rails
addons.blurb: Everything Create's trains were missing.

quests.desc: Buffers cap a line so a train has something to stop against.
A bench cart, for the parts of a railway that carry people.
Narrow and mono buffers, for the lines that are not standard gauge.

addons.title: Create: Radars
addons.blurb: See further than you can build.

quests.desc: Binoculars first. The data link carries what a radar sees to somewhere useful.
Plates and a bearing make a dish that actually sweeps.
A monitor to read it, and a filter so it only reports what matters.

addons.title: Create: Propulsion
addons.blurb: Thrust, cabling, and contraption tooling.

quests.desc: Cable and relays. Longer reach than Create's own wiring.
Auto glue sticks a build together without clicking every face.
A hub to gather cables, and a remover for when it all goes wrong.

addons.title: Stuff & Additions
addons.blurb: Tools, armour and gadgets, in Create's own materials.

quests.desc: Brass tools. Not stronger than iron — they just belong here.
Brass armour to match. Cosmetic more than practical, and that is fine.
A block picker, and a brass cube for the recipes that ask for one.

addons.title: Create: Factory
addons.blurb: Food processing, industrialised.

quests.desc: Paste and nectar. The two things most recipes here start from.
Rolls, because a factory should feed the people running it.
Waffles and jam. Yes, this is a whole tech tree.

addons.title: Additional Logistics
addons.blurb: Lazy shafts, and a view of the whole network.

quests.desc: Lazy parts only tick when something changes. Free performance.
A flexible shaft bends around a corner without a gearbox.
A network monitor shows every train and station at once.

addons.title: Create: Deep Seas
addons.blurb: Down, instead of up.

quests.desc: Ballast tanks flood to sink and blow to rise. A vent controls the rate.
A barometer reads depth. A rudder decides where you go.
A propeller to move, and a diffuser so the crew keeps breathing.

addons.title: Create: Escalated
addons.blurb: Walkways and escalators that carry you.

quests.desc: Steps and rail. A walkway is just these two, repeated.
An escalator section, and the terminal that ends it.
Wood and glass variants, for when steel is too industrial.

addons.title: Bits 'n' Bobs
addons.blurb: Small parts that fill in Create's gaps.

quests.desc: Bulbs and lamps. Lighting that suits the aesthetic.
Chain rope and a pulley, for lifts that are not rope pulleys.
Flanged cogs and girder struts. Structural, and they look the part.

addons.title: Copycats+
addons.blurb: Make any shape look like any block.

quests.desc: The plain block and the base it is made from. Start here.
Beams and boards. Structure that wears whatever texture you give it.
Catwalks and ladders, so the industrial parts match the build.

addons.title: More Girders
addons.blurb: Girders in more metals and more shapes.

quests.desc: Copper beams and trusses. Warmer than iron, and they age nicely.
The brass set. Matches everything else brass in the pack.
Brackets and struts, to join them without it looking accidental.

addons.title: Enchantment Industry
addons.blurb: Automate the enchanting table.

quests.desc: Liquid experience. Yes, really — it pipes like any other fluid.
A blaze enchanter applies a template instead of a random roll.
The forger repairs and combines. The bag carries the mess.

addons.title: Dreams n' Desires
addons.blurb: More kinetics, and some genuinely odd machines.

quests.desc: A crank that takes a cog directly. Hand power, less fiddly.
A gauge and a hatch, so tanks stop being guesswork.
A burner and asphalt. Industrial groundwork.

addons.title: Create: Broken Bad
addons.blurb: Chemistry. Handle with more care than usual.

quests.desc: Crushed ores. The starting point for every reaction here.
Matches, and a bell for the front of a shop.
Iodine and seeds. What you do next is between you and the server rules.

addons.title: Aquatic Ambitions
addons.blurb: Ocean materials and conduits.

quests.desc: Shards and shells, from things that did not want to give them up.
Prismarine alloy and rods. Underwater building material.
A mechanical conduit, and powder to keep it fed.

addons.title: Create: Goggles
addons.blurb: Goggles on a helmet, so you stop having to choose.

quests.desc: Leather and iron. Armour and goggle readouts at the same time.
Backtanks in more metals, holding more air.
Diving variants, for the parts of the build that are underwater.

addons.title: Create: Hypertube
addons.blurb: Get across the base without walking.

quests.desc: Tube and an entrance. Step in, come out somewhere else.
Junctions branch. Funnels feed items in without a player.
An accelerator for distance, and a scanner to see what is inside.

addons.title: Extra Gauges
addons.blurb: Readouts and logic for display boards.

quests.desc: Integer and string gauges. Put a number or a word on a board.
Comparator and logic gauges, for boards that decide things.
A linked lever and a redstone port, to wire it into the rest.

addons.title: Hose Connectors
addons.blurb: Move fluids and items between separate contraptions.

quests.desc: A hose for fluid, and one for items. Both cross the gap between ships.
Chains hold two builds together. Magnets do it without a hard link.
Electric connectors, for when the other side needs power too.

addons.title: Create: Solar
addons.blurb: Free power, if the sky cooperates.

quests.desc: A panel and sunglasses. One makes power, the other is a statement.
A growth lamp for crops, and a sculk panel for power without daylight.
More panels. An array beats a single panel every time.

addons.title: Slice & Dice
addons.blurb: Farming automation that fits on a contraption.

quests.desc: A slicer harvests. A sprinkler waters. Together, that is a farm.
Fertiliser, in solid and liquid form.
More sprinklers, and something to grow with them.

addons.title: Package Couriers
addons.blurb: Packages that deliver themselves.

quests.desc: Parts and a transmitter. The transmitter is the address.
A finished plane, and a ticker so you can order from anywhere.
More transmitters. Every destination needs its own.
